subject: Penetration test: request for final validation attestation (ZenBridge)
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <secops@zenbridge.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.example
Cc: secops@zenbridge.com
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: final validation / attestation after remediation

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for working with ZenBridge on the recent penetration test. The vendor completed their technical report and flagged a small set of findings (primarily an API gateway misconfiguration and one third-party dependency vulnerability). Our team has a follow-up retest window available next week.

We need a short attestation letter from Redwood once the retest confirms the fixes. Specifically we ask for:
- A one-paragraph attestation confirming the named issues were remediated and verified by third-party retest (or an internal QA retest if vendor retest is not possible).
- A delta report or summary that lists which CVEs/IDs were rechecked and the result (closed / partial / still open).
- Any supporting evidence you can share (screenshots, patch commit IDs, staging access for retest).

Proposed retest windows: 2027-04-28 or 2027-04-29 (10:00–18:00 PT). Can you confirm availability and who we should coordinate with for the staging endpoint?

Attachments: zenbridge-retest-initial-scope.pdf (scope & vuln IDs).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our compliance team is on a tight timeline to close their control testing.

Best,
Alex Nguyen
Customer Security Lead — ZenBridge
secops@zenbridge.com
(attachment: zenbridge-retest-initial-scope.pdf)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example
To: Alex Nguyen <secops@zenbridge.com>, ben_carter@redwood.example
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.example
Date: 2027-04-27T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: final validation / attestation after remediation

Hi Alex — quick status update and evidence package.

Summary of remediation work (done 2027-04-24 → 2027-04-26):
- API gateway: fixed header routing misconfiguration that allowed unauthenticated OPTIONS preflight on internal endpoints (ticket SEC-482).
- Third-party dependency: upgraded lib-crypto to 2.3.1 (addresses CVE-2027-1123); backported minimal compatibility fixes and ran full regression tests.

Artifacts attached: remediation-evidence-zenbridge.zip (screenshots, staged config snapshots), patch-commit-ids.txt (commit hashes: 1a2b3c, 4d5e6f).

Staging access for retest: https://staging-api.redwood.example (basic auth credentials sent via separate secure channel). Proposed retest slot: 2027-04-28 13:00–17:00 PT.

Scope for retest: we suggest narrowing to the two confirmed items in the attached scope document: CVE-2027-1123 and the API gateway misconfig. If ZenBridge prefers a fuller regression sweep, we can open a second window.

Internal confirmation: fixes were deployed to staging and smoke-tested by QA on 2027-04-26 at 21:00 PT. Regression test run id: run-20270426-21.

Let us know if the 4/28 slot works and where to send the temporary credentials.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example
(attachments: remediation-evidence-zenbridge.zip, patch-commit-ids.txt)
